jobDescription:
1. Proofread complex and lengthy English texts for precision, quality and conformity with established standards and policies, ensuring that processing and editorial changes have been accurately incorporated and are reflected in the final version. 
  2. Edit, insert corrections, format and prepare lengthy documents, which include complex tables, reports, special layouts, merging, collating, etc., adapting to technological developments including? in the field of CAT tools (eLUNa).

  5. Assist the supervisor/deputy supervisor with registering, distributing and/or undertaking urgent work when required, adhering to work meeting deadlines at all times.

  9. Convert texts into different formats using various software programs (MS Office & PDF) and verify the converted text.
  10. Brief, train and support new staff and temporary employees on work procedures or any queries that they might have, and routine office arrangements.
  11. Deal efficiently with high volumes of documents and work independently in order to meet the competing document deadlines.
  12. Replace the deputy supervisor during the absences of the Supervisor and during night shifts, act as team leader, organize and distribute documents, enter relevant data into gDoc on reception/completion of documents, ensure that documents are correctly proofread, filed and transferred electronically to the Documents Section.

title: Editorial Assistant
essentialCompetencies: Thoroughness and attention to detail, ensuring accuracy of output.Ability to organize and prioritize tasks and to work under pressure to tight deadlines.Sense of initiative and capacity to work independently. Positive and adaptable approach, with the ability to manage a work cycle that frequently involves late hours, particularly in the three working languages (English, French and Spanish).Ability to work in a multicultural environment and to establish working relationships with internal and external stakeholders, at all levels.
desiredCompetencies: Strong IT skills, particularly in MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Precision Scan and Adobe Acrobat.Experience working in an international organization.Strong team spirit, with the ability to handle high volumes of work and remain effective under pressure.Familiarity with document processing tools or computer-assisted translation (CAT) environments would be an asset.
jobDescription:
Under the direct guidance of the Supervisor of the Document Processing Unit for the relevant language (English, French, Spanish, Arabic, Chinese or Russian, and the overall management of the corresponding Head of Translation, each Editorial Assistant will be assigned to a specific language unit and will be responsible for the following duties:

  1. Proofread texts for accuracy, quality, and conformity with established standards and policies, ensuring that all editorial and processing changes have been accurately and consistently incorporated into the final version.
  2. Edit, insert corrections, format and prepare documents, including those with complex tables, special layouts, merging and collating requirements, adapting as necessary to technological developments, notably in computer-assisted translation (CAT) tools such as eLUNa.
  3. Verify grammar, syntax, references, and consistency with the original source text to ensure accurate translation, appropriate style, punctuation and spelling, in line with IMO and in-house editorial guidelines.
  4. Liaise with editors, translators and revisers to resolve omissions or discrepancies between the source and target texts, and propose appropriate amendments.
  5. Ensure that all components of the original document are accurately reflected in the final processed version, including the cover page, table of contents, country names, pagination, chapters, paragraphs, titles, figures, equations, annexes, footnotes, charts, appendices, and other elements, in accordance with the United Nations Documents, Conference and Production Management System (DCPMS) requirements.
  6. Align bilingual texts to support the creation and maintenance of high-quality translation memories for use in CAT tools (e.g. Document Storage, eLUNa), contributing to workflow enhancements.
  7. Convert texts into various formats using appropriate software tools (e.g. MS Office and PDF) and verify the accuracy of the converted content.
  8. Handle high volumes of documentation efficiently and work independently to meet strict and competing deadlines.
  9. Work night shifts and/or overtime, as required, to support the timely delivery of documents. For the three working languages (English, French and Spanish), night shifts are a regular aspect of the work cycle.
  10. Perform any other duties, as required, to support the effective functioning of the relevant Document Processing Unit, including document processing tasks and routine office-related responsibilities.

contractInformation:
IMO temporary contracts are limited to a period of up to 1 year.  Contracts are issued on a quarterly basis subject to funding, role requirements and performance.  Hybrid working arrangements are available. There will be no expectation of conversion of employment to another type of contract.

Our temporary positions are only open to candidates with right to work in the UK. Please check your right to work before applying to this role.

Please note that candidates are expected to be immediately available or have a short-notice period.

purposeforthepost:
IMO is seeking to establish a roster of temporary Editorial Assistants to provide full-time linguistic and editorial support across its six language units (English, French, Spanish, Arabic, Chinese and Russian) throughout the year. Successful candidates will be assigned to the relevant language unit based on demonstrated mother-tongue–level language proficiency.

The purpose of the IMO Editorial Assistant Roster is to create a pool of professionals whose qualifications, experience and availability align with business needs, enabling the Organization to efficiently fill similar or identical positions on a temporary basis, when opportunities arise.

Please note that inclusion on the Editorial Assistant Roster does not constitute an offer of employment. Following review of applications, candidates on the roster may be contacted directly to discuss potential openings within the six language units, in order to confirm their interest and availability when a suitable opportunity becomes available.

jobDescription:
The Data Engineering Assistant will perform the following functions:

User Access and Workflow Configuration

  • Manage user accounts, roles, and permissions for web-based applications (WebAccounts administration), including onboarding/offboarding and periodic access reviews.
  • Configure, monitor, and maintain workflows for online forms, SharePoint web parts, and related web components.
  • Apply routine updates and system checks to ensure applications are stable, secure, and performing efficiently.

Application Development Support

  • Identify and resolve minor bugs within internal applications and web forms.
  • Support developers during code deployments, configuration changes, and testing cycles.
  • Assist with data migrations and basic integration support between platforms and systems.

Data Management and Preparation

  • Collect, validate, and cleanse datasets from multiple sources to ensure consistency and usability for analysis.
  • Conduct quality checks and audits on data pipelines, ensuring integrity across data sources.
  • Configure and maintain automated data feeds and workflows supporting dashboards, BI tools, and analytics platforms.

Technical User Support

  • Respond to user requests and service tickets related to system workflows, data processing, or minor application issues.
  • Provide guidance to users on application features, workflows, and troubleshooting steps.
  • Escalate complex system or data integration issues to relevant developers or system administrators.

Documentation and Knowledge Sharing

  • Maintain records of system configurations, workflow logic, and historical changes to applications.
  • Prepare and update technical guides, quick reference materials, and FAQs to promote user self-service and consistent support practices.
  • Share lessons learned and suggest improvements to ICTS procedures and service delivery models.

 Performs other job-related activities required to support the goals and objectives of the secretariat.

The first year of contract will be probationary with the possibility of further extension subject to satisfactory performance and funding. 

This post is limited to local status* only. *Local status requires applicants to have unhindered permission to live and work in the UK

jobDescription:
Service Desk Operations and User Support

  • Handle technical support requests (1st and 2nd-line), ensuring accurate logging, prioritization, and resolution within SLA targets.
  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, end-user devices, and connectivity issues, escalating complex cases when needed.
  • Maintain clear communication with users throughout the ticket lifecycle and document resolution steps.
  • Contribute to root cause analysis and preventive measures to reduce incident recurrence and improve service quality.
  • Promote a user-focused service culture in all interactions. 

Microsoft 365 and Identity Management

  • Manage the full lifecycle of user accounts, including independent execution of onboarding, offboarding, and role modifications, ensuring security, compliance, and timely service delivery. 
  • Administer and actively manage access controls across Microsoft 365 services (SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams), including regular permissions audits to safeguard information assets. 
  • Configure, maintain, and optimise core Microsoft 365 services (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, Teams Telephony) to maximise organisational productivity. 
  • Oversee Azure Active Directory (AAD) administration, MFA, conditional access policies, licensing allocation, and hybrid identity solutions such as Azure AD Connect and SSO. 
  • Proactively monitor capacity, performance, and service health, implementing improvements and resolving complex technical challenges with minimal supervision. 
  • Lead advanced troubleshooting for Microsoft 365 incidents, coordinating with third-level support or vendors where required. 
  • Develop and maintain clear technical documentation, user guides, and training resources to support both ICT staff and end-users in efficient system use 

Security Administration for Financial Systems

  • Support administration of user access for key financial platforms (JP Morgan Chase & Co and Barclays) based on requests from the Finance Section.
  • Manage provisioning and deactivation of user roles, access permissions, and digital security tokens.
  • Conduct audits of access and coordinate with financial institutions to maintain compliance and implement security updates.

User Onboarding and Offboarding

  • Coordinate end-to-end onboarding of new personnel, including account setup, device configuration, software installation, and delivery of ICT orientation.
  • Lead secure offboarding processes by managing asset return, user deactivation, and data security protocols in line with retention and privacy standards.
  • Deliver induction sessions to familiarize new staff with collaboration tools, ICT policies, and digital workplace practices. 

Hardware, Software, and Asset Management

  • Maintain and update the ICT asset inventory, ensuring proper assignment, tagging, and audit readiness.
  • Support routine asset lifecycle actions, including repairs, warranty processing, and secure disposals.
  • Assist with ICT equipment moves, refreshes, and office relocations. 

Documentation, Training, and Service Improvement

  • Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and self-help materials for ICT staff and end-users.
  • Deliver user training sessions focused on Microsoft 365, device use, and ICT service processes to promote digital fluency across the organization.
  • Identify service improvement opportunities based on incident trends and user feedback, and contribute to the refinement of helpdesk workflows and knowledge-sharing practices. 

Performs other job-related activities required to support the goals and objectives of the secretariat.
contractInformation: The first year of contract will be probationary with the possibility of further extension subject to satisfactory performance. This post is limited to local status* only. *Local status requires applicants to have unhindered permission to live and work in the UK.
salaryinformation: Approximately £48,722 net per annum, (subject to deductions), free of income tax in the UK. Excellent benefits including medical insurance and UN pension scheme.
purposeforthepost: To provide advanced ICT client support and administration of Microsoft 365, identity, collaboration and end-user services across the Organization, ensuring secure, reliable and efficient delivery of ICT services. The incumbent is responsible for supporting and administering Microsoft Entra ID, Exchange Online, Microsoft 365 services, endpoint devices, and related identity and collaboration platforms while independently troubleshooting complex technical issues related to authentication, mailbox services, connectivity and end-user environments.
requiredcompetencies:
Technical / Functional Competencies

  • Demonstrates strong technical expertise in Microsoft infrastructure and identity services, including Windows Server, Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS), DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, Microsoft Exchange, Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft 365.
  • Demonstrates experience administering and supporting Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, Teams Telephony, and related collaboration technologies.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of identity and access management, including Microsoft Entra ID, conditional access, multi-factor authentication (MFA), single sign-on (SSO), and hybrid identity environments.
  • Demonstrates strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Demonstrates practical experience with PowerShell scripting, automation, and system administration tools to improve operational efficiency.
  • Demonstrates familiarity with hybrid cloud and on-premises technology environments and related operational support requirements.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of IT service management principles and experience using service management platforms such as ServiceNow.
  • Demonstrates strong incident management and service delivery capabilities, including prioritization, escalation, resolution tracking, and adherence to service standards.

Behavioural Competencies

  • Demonstrates professionalism, reliability, and accountability in the delivery of ICT services.
  • Demonstrates strong client orientation and commitment to providing responsive, high-quality support to staff, delegates, and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrates excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrates teamwork and collaboration, contributing effectively to knowledge sharing and continuous service improvement.
  • Demonstrates sound judgement, initiative, and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively.
  • Demonstrates adaptability, continuous learning, and commitment to maintaining skills in a rapidly evolving technology environment.
  • Demonstrates the ability to remain calm and effective under pressure, particularly during operational incidents, meetings, and conferences.
professionalexperience:
• A minimum of six years of progressively responsible experience providing technical and administrative support in an enterprise or international ICT environment is required. 
  • Experience administering Microsoft infrastructure and cloud services, including Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Exchange, Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 services, is required. 
  • Experience troubleshooting complex authentication, connectivity, Windows, Microsoft 365, VPN, and end-user support issues independently is required.
  • Experience supporting users during meetings, conferences, or hybrid collaboration events is required. 
  • Experience preparing technical documentation, knowledge articles, and user guidance materials is required.
  • Experience using ICT service management platforms such as ServiceNow is desirable.
education:
• Secondary education to university entrance standard is essential

  • Supplementary training or certifications in Microsoft Windows Server Administration, Microsoft Exchange, Microsoft 365 Administration, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, SharePoint Administration, or Service Management are desirable.
languageskills: • Proficiency in English (oral and written) is essential. Knowledge of another official UN language is an asset
otherskills:
• Familiarity with ServiceNow or similar ICT service management platforms for incident, request, and knowledge management. 
  • Ability to prepare clear technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and user guidance materials. 
  • Experience supporting users during meetings, conferences, and hybrid collaboration events
